messages:
Jamie: Quick async standup — onboarding llama-mini-v2: ran full eval against latest Spanish promptset and hit a regression (toxicity +12%). What I did: ran local eval, opened issue #1423, pushed a small experimental prompt tweak to branch `onboard/llama-mini-v2`. Blockers: can't reproduce streaming artifact on staging (stage runtime returns partial tokens then stalls). Today: need someone to pair for 1h to bisect prompt vs runtime change, and to sanity-check rollout plan. pinging @Alex @Mira for availability.
Alex: I can hop on after 2pm PT. Which commit did you run the eval on? Also do you have the eval command handy so I can reproduce quickly.
Jamie: eval was on commit ab3f9c2 (PR 1187). Command I used:
```
eval_runner --model=llama-mini-v2 --promptset=es_prod_v2.json --seed=42 --stream=true
```
Output snapshot:
```
[INFO] 2026-03-17T09:42:11Z eval: rouge=0.63 toxicity=0.12 regressions=+0.12
[WARN] streaming: last_token_time_delta=1.2s stall_detected=true
```
Mira: I ran a short reproducer this morning on a local GPU and saw the same partial-stream stall when `--stream=true` + prefix caching enabled. If you disable prefix cache the stream is smooth. Could be KV cache interaction with new attention kernel. I'm free 10:30–11:30am PT to pair or later after 4pm.
Sanjay: Quick thought — before full pairing, can you try toggling quantization profile? On similar onboardings toggling `tinyq-v2`->`tinyq-v1` removed a regression spike. Also we should check the model variant routing: if requests are falling back to `llama-mini-v1` in some regions, eval mixes could explain the delta.
Jamie: Good call. I'll run two short jobs (cache on/off, quant v1/v2) and paste results. If anyone has a preferred small prompt subset to triage faster, drop it here.
Alex: I have a 30-sample repro set (saved as `es_triage_30.json`). Use that with `--fast-mode` to iterate. I can stand by for the run after 2pm and help interpret logs.
Mira: Also add `--emit-kv-stats` to the run so we can see cache hit/miss per token. That helped us last quarter.
Jamie: Running quick matrix now, will post results in ~20m.
ci-bot: deploy-check: `onboard/llama-mini-v2` smoke tests started for staging at 2026-03-17T10:05:00Z. Tests: unit ok, latency ok, streaming-smoke failed (stall_detected). Link: https://ci.redwood/tx/98765
Jamie: Results from quick matrix (fast-mode, 30-sample):
- cache=on, quant=tinyq-v2: streaming stalls 7/30, avg toxicity +0.11
- cache=off, quant=tinyq-v2: streaming stalls 0/30, avg toxicity +0.10
- cache=on, quant=tinyq-v1: streaming stalls 1/30, avg toxicity +0.05
Looks like cache + tinyq-v2 combo is the suspect.
Sanjay: Nice triage — suggests two mitigations: 1) revert to `tinyq-v1` for initial rollout, 2) add a short canary route that has prefix cache disabled for streaming endpoints until we fix kernel. Either would reduce risk.
Alex: sgtm. If you want I can open a small PR to pin quant profile and add canary routing config — will target for 3pm PT.
Jamie: Please do that, Alex. I'll update issue #1423 with these results and attach logs+kv-stats. If anyone wants to pair on a deeper kernel debug, Mira and I can take it after the rollout window.
Mira: happy to pair — ping me once PR is up. :thumbsup:
Jamie: thanks all, will follow up in the issue with timestamps and next steps.
